metadata.title: XFELs and Xarion: science-scale free-electron lasers vs IQT laser-acoustics

entities.name: Xarion_Laser_Acoustics
entities.notes: Vienna. Optical microphone / laser-ultrasound sensing (no membrane). IQT Wikipedia infrastructure list. Not an XFEL and not a lithography light source. Sensing/NDT, not a 3 km accelerator.

entities.name: SACLA
entities.notes: SPring-8 Angstrom Compact Free Electron Laser. Harima Science Garden City (Sayo, Hyogo), Japan. RIKEN-operated hard XFEL: electrons accelerated to produce ultra-short, intense X-ray pulses for atomic structure, ultrafast chemistry, and materials. Compact relative to km-scale FELs; still a user-science machine, not a fab tool.

entities.name: SPring_8
entities.notes: RIKEN/JASRI synchrotron on the same Harima campus as SACLA. Storage-ring X-rays complementary to the XFEL.

entities.name: European_XFEL
entities.notes: European X-Ray Free-Electron Laser. 3.4 km superconducting linac from DESY (Hamburg-Bahrenfeld) to the Schenefeld campus. Up to 17.5 GeV, ~27,000 pulses/s. 12 member states. User facility for biomolecules, materials, ultrafast dynamics. Not a lithography scanner.

entities.name: DESY
entities.notes: Deutsches Elektronen-Synchrotron, Hamburg. Hosts the European XFEL injector/accelerator; ~240 DESY staff run the linac. FLASH is DESY's own (softer) FEL.

entities.name: LCLS
entities.notes: Linac Coherent Light Source at SLAC, Menlo Park. US hard XFEL; LCLS-II superconducting upgrade. Science user facility, same physics family as SACLA and European XFEL.

entities.name: SLAC
entities.notes: SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory. Operates LCLS.

entities.name: SwissFEL
entities.notes: Paul Scherrer Institute, Villigen. Hard/soft XFEL in the same global set as SACLA, LCLS, European XFEL.

entities.name: PAL_XFEL
entities.notes: Pohang Accelerator Laboratory, Korea. Hard XFEL.
